inputs.commit_message: Complete ASOL control production cutover from canonical workspace
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/hesham/gova
expected=$(printf '%s\n' \
  'docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/catalogs/repository-catalog.md' \
  'docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/catalogs/runtime-catalog.md' \
  'docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/graphs/knowledge-graph.json' \
  'docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/graphs/search-index.json' \
  'docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/reports/graph-health.md' | sort)
actual=$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | sed -E 's/^.. //' | sort)
echo '=== canonical generated drift safety check ==='
printf '%s\n' "$actual"
if [ "$actual" != "$expected" ]; then
  echo 'Canonical workspace contains tracked changes outside the five proven generated artifacts; refusing cleanup.'
  exit 42
fi
git restore --source=HEAD -- \
  docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/catalogs/repository-catalog.md \
  docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/catalogs/runtime-catalog.md \
  docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/graphs/knowledge-graph.json \
  docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/graphs/search-index.json \
  docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated/reports/graph-health.md
test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)"
echo '=== canonical workspace sync ==='
git fetch --prune origin main
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
git pull --ff-only origin main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)"
echo head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
test -f .vercel/project.json
echo '=== canonical generated knowledge determinism ==='
npm run docs:generate
git diff --exit-code -- docs/09-agent-knowledge/generated
npm run docs:ci
echo '=== atomic production cutover ==='
NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_CONTROL_URL=https://asol-control.vercel.app NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_SUBMAIN_URL=https://asol-submain.vercel.app NEXT_PUBLIC_ASOL_SUB2MAIN_URL=https://asol-sub2main.vercel.app npm run deploy:all
